steps.zh: 装上 GitHub CLI 扩展

steps.en: Write the chore as Markdown: trigger, permissions and allowed writes up top, instructions below
steps.zh: 把杂活写成 Markdown：头部写触发、权限和允许的写操作，正文写指令

steps.en: Compile it into a lock file and commit both files
steps.zh: 编译出 lock 文件，两个文件一起提交

steps.en: On the trigger, runs your chosen agent read-only in a firewalled container
steps.zh: 触发时，在带防火墙的容器里只读地跑你选的 agent

component.zh: agent 作业 + AWF 防火墙

steps.en: Screens the agent's output, then a separate scoped job files the issue, comment or PR
steps.zh: 先筛查 agent 的产出，再由单独的限权作业开 issue、评论或 PR

value.en: Judgment chores (triage, CI-failure digging, status reports) run on their own, and the agent never holds a write token
value.zh: 分诊、查 CI 失败、写周报这类要动脑的杂活自己跑起来，而 agent 手里始终没有写权限的 token

sources: README 'Quick Start' (verbatim: gh extension install github/gh-aw) and 'How Agentic Workflows work' (frontmatter + Markdown body; gh aw compile generates the .lock.yml)
docs/src/content/docs/setup/quick-start.mdx (Step 4: run gh aw compile, commit both the .md source and the generated .lock.yml)
.github/workflows/daily-team-status.md (frontmatter keys on:, permissions:, safe-outputs: with create-issue)

docs/src/content/docs/reference/faq.md ('Does the underlying AI engine run in a sandbox?' — agent container + Agent Workflow Firewall; 'Can they write to the repository?' — read-only agent step, safe outputs applied in separate jobs)
docs/src/content/docs/reference/threat-detection.md (threat detection job runs after the agent job, before safe outputs are applied)
